description: Scoped IPC capability for the embedded nibbin.com Grove webview. Grants the full thin-shell bridge command set to content loaded from https://nibbin.com. Security model: (a) targets the 'grove' webview label only — not the 'main' webview; (b) sets local:false so local app content cannot use this capability; (c) uses an exact-origin URLPattern (no wildcard subdomains) matching ONLY the hardcoded https://nibbin.com/* origin — capabilities are compiled in at build time and cannot read environment variables, so NIBBIN_GROVE_HANDOFF or any staging URL is NOT covered here. The on_navigation lock in lib.rs (grove_show) provides defense-in-depth by blocking same-webview navigation to any other host. Together these two layers ensure no other origin — including attacker-controlled redirects — can reach these commands. Write/control commands (send_control, create_study, review_delete, review_keep, add_exclusion, remove_exclusion) are included because the two-layer containment model makes the nibbin.com webview a trusted origin equivalent to the native desktop UI; the daemon remains the sole enforcer of C2/C3/C4/C5. Full rationale in bridge-read.toml.
